jobs.title: Director, Systems Engineering - ENT R&D
jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 9 Sep 2026

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Across our global Neuroscience organization, we advance care for some of medicine’s most complex neurological and spinal conditions. By combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, and deep clinical expertise, we partner with physicians and health systems to improve how patients are treated and supported throughout their care journey.

Our Ear, Nose & Throat (ENT) Operating Unit provides innovative technologies that support clinicians in treating sinus, otology, head and neck, skull base, airway, and related conditions. Our ENT technology includes powered instruments, image-guided surgical systems, and sinus implants that enhance precision, safety, and efficiency across both office and operating room settings—helping improve patient outcomes in a complex and evolving specialty.

Check us out on LinkedIn: Medtronic ENT

The Director of Systems Engineering leads a multidisciplinary engineering organization responsible for the design, integration, and lifecycle management of complex medical device systems within the ENT Operating Unit. This role drives systems architecture, requirements management, cross-functional integration, and risk oversight while partnering across hardware, software, firmware, and clinical teams to deliver reliable, innovative solutions. The leader will establish systems-level strategies and scalable engineering processes that improve product quality, accelerate time to market, and support the continued advancement of sophisticated ENT therapies and technologies.

Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead, build, and scale a high-performing Systems Engineering organization, including hiring, succession planning, and leadership development.
Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, engagement, and continuous improvement to drive retention and organizational performance.
Serve as a transformational leader and change agent, advancing organizational effectiveness and cross-functional collaboration across R&D.

Systems Engineering Strategy & Talent Development

Develop and advance systems engineering capabilities aligned with emerging methodologies and ENT therapy area needs.
Drive consistent application of DRM and systems engineering best practices across R&D functions.
Provide functional leadership and operational oversight of the Systems Engineering organization.
Mentor and develop engineering talent to build a strong pipeline of future technical and organizational leaders.

System Architecture & Concept Development

Define and influence ENT platform and system architecture strategy in collaboration with Upstream Marketing to ensure portfolio differentiation and long-term competitiveness.
Translate scientific, clinical, and technological insights into scalable system architectures and a clear product development roadmap.
Partner with clinical experts and advisory networks to validate technical direction and inform design decisions.
Influence cross-functional priorities and ensure alignment of architecture decisions with business and product strategy.
Communicate architectural vision, trade-offs, and technical strategy to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Systems Development & Integration

Lead systems engineering execution within a Core Team Model to enable high-quality, compliant, and on-time product launches.
Own system-level requirements and architecture across therapy delivery systems, devices, programmers, and accessories.
Ensure seamless integration across hardware, software, and firmware development partners.
Drive technology reuse and platform standardization to improve efficiency, scalability, and development speed.

 This role will require <25% of travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

Must Have

Bachelor's degree with 10 years of relevant experience OR Masters degree with 8 years of relevant experience
7 years of managerial experience
Strong foundation in systems engineering disciplines, ideally in electrical, mechanical, biomedical, and software engineering
Experience developing and delivering highly complex, high-reliability systems and technologies in regulated environments

Nice to Have

Medical device industry experience with Class I, II, or III regulated products
Progressive leadership experience managing complex medical device technology and product portfolios, with responsibility for both strategic direction and tactical execution
Proven ability to lead cross-functional, matrixed teams and drive alignment across engineering, clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders
Demonstrated business acumen with strong executive presence and clear, effective communication skills across all organizational levels
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities with a track record of data-driven decision-making

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.

214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager / Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Dollamur is seeking a dynamic engineering leader to join our team in either an Engineering Manager
or Director of Engineering
capacity, depending on the candidate's qualifications, leadership experience, and demonstrated impact within a manufacturing environment.

This role provides a unique opportunity for accomplished engineering professionals to lead continuous improvement initiatives, drive manufacturing excellence, optimize processes, and enhance product quality across the organization. Candidates selected at the Manager level will have a clear pathway for growth into the Director role through expanded leadership responsibilities, strategic project ownership, and organizational development opportunities. Candidates hired at the Director level will serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, helping shape operational strategy and long-term organizational success. The position supervises two team members.

Regardless of level, the successful candidate will play a critical role in advancing manufacturing performance, developing technical talent, supporting operational scalability, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Applicable to both Engineering Manager and Director of Engineering levels

Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, SPC, Theory of Constraints (TOC), and other operational excellence methodologies.
Drive manufacturing process optimization, process standardization, workflow improvements, and engineering support for production operations.
Partner closely with Operations, Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Leadership teams to achieve organizational objectives.
Analyze operational, quality, and production metrics to identify trends, improve efficiencies, and support data-driven decision-making.
Support new product development, manufacturing implementation, and process scalability initiatives.
Lead root cause analysis, corrective action activities, and quality improvement efforts to improve product consistency and customer satisfaction.
Oversee engineering support for manufacturing technologies, automation initiatives, equipment implementation, and process modernization activities.
Develop, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures, engineering documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Manage engineering projects, priorities, and resources while ensuring objectives are completed on time and within budget.
Champion workplace safety initiatives and identify opportunities to improve ergonomic, operational, and process safety.
Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and cross-functional teams regarding manufacturing capabilities, equipment, product requirements, and process improvements.
Support ERP, MES, manufacturing analytics, and process documentation systems to improve operational visibility and efficiency.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Engineering Manager

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline required.
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing, industrial, quality, or process engineering experience.
Minimum of 2 years of engineering leadership, project leadership, or supervisory experience preferred.
Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, SPC, TOC, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting manufacturing process optimization, quality systems, and operational improvement initiatives.
Working knowledge of ERP systems, manufacturing analytics, BOM management, routing structures, and production costing.
Experience using CAD software and engineering documentation systems preferred.
Six Sigma Green Belt certification preferred.
Experience supporting MES implementations or manufacturing technology initiatives is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production workflows, and quality systems.
Ability to identify waste and implement effective solutions that improve efficiency, quality, safety, and cost performance.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement capabilities.
Ability to perform statistical analysis and apply engineering principles to operational challenges.
Experience creating layouts, workflows, work instructions, SOPs, and process documentation.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, production data, and quality metrics.
Effective project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ERP systems, CAD software, and manufacturing technologies.
Ability to work collaboratively with production personnel, leadership teams, suppliers, and customers.
Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
Spanish language skills are a plus but not required.

Director of Engineering

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field required.
Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
Minimum of 7-10 years of manufacturing engineering, operational engineering, or industrial engineering experience required.
Minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams, quality functions, or technical organizations.
Strong background in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, process improvement, and manufacturing systems optimization.
Experience managing cross-functional engineering and quality initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
Experience with ERP systems, manufacturing analytics, and process documentation systems required.
Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification required.
Experience designing, developing, implementing, or leading Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) or similar production management platforms preferred.
Demonstrated success leading organizational improvement initiatives that drive measurable operational and financial results.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development skills with the ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams.
Ability to develop and execute engineering strategies aligned with operational objectives and long-term business growth.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production systems, quality systems, and operational workflows.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to lead large-scale operational improvement initiatives and execute strategic engineering projects across multiple functions.
Strong financial and operational acumen related to manufacturing efficiency, capital investments, productivity improvement, and cost reduction.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ERP systems, CAD software, manufacturing technologies, and data analytics tools.
Strong project and portfolio management capabilities with the ability to balance multiple strategic priorities.
Ability to interpret complex engineering, operational, and financial data and translate insights into actionable business decisions.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive team.
Ability to communicate complex engineering strategies and business initiatives in a manner that is understandable and engaging to associates at all levels of the organization.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining a focus on quality, execution, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Dollamur?

At Dollamur, engineering is more than process improvement. It is a critical driver of innovation, operational excellence, and business growth. Whether joining as an Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering, you will have the opportunity to influence manufacturing strategy, improve operational performance, develop future leaders, and make a meaningful impact on the organization's continued success. We are committed to investing in talented leaders and providing opportunities for professional growth, advancement, and long-term career development.

jobs.title: Director - AI Platform Strategy
jobs.description:
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for 30 days, from 03-Sep-2026. The posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Join a financial services firm where your contributions are valued. Edward Jones is a Fortune 500¹ company where people come first. With over 9 million clients and 20,000 financial advisors across the U.S. and Canada, we’re proud to be privately-owned, placing the focus on our clients rather than shareholder returns.

Behind everything we do is our purpose: We partner for positive impact to improve the lives of our clients and colleagues, and together, better our communities and society. We are an innovative, flexible, and inclusive organization that attracts, develops, and inspires performance excellence and a sense of belonging.

People are at the center of our partnership. Edward Jones associates are seen, heard, respected, and supported. This is what we believe makes us the best place to start or build your career.

View our Purpose, Inclusion and Citizenship Report.

¹Fortune 500, published June 2024, data as of December 2023. Compensation provided for using, not obtaining, the rating.

Opportunity Overview

The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Platform Strategy
is responsible for driving the AI platform vision, strategy, and cross-functional coordination across the AI Platform team acting as the lead for AI vendor engagement. This role establishes and optimizes the platforms, environments, and enabling infrastructure required to develop, deploy, monitor, and scale artificial intelligence solutions. Focuses on creating secure, reliable, interoperable, and reusable foundations for enterprise AI delivery and operations.

Unlike ‑Product Managers within the Digital Product Management organization, this role treats AI itself as the product
—owning firmwide, reusable, and scalable AI platform capabilities that power AI builder experiences and AI products rather than discrete applications.

This role centers on strategy, discovery, and value framing, working closely with each Business and Functional area to shape AI direction, identify high‑value opportunities, and expand the art of the possible for how AI can transform their domain. Digital Product Managers will often serve as customers of the AI Product Manager, and leverage AI Products as part of their offerings. Digital Product Managers will remain accountable for the execution, delivery, and lifecycle management of AI capabilities within products and portfolios. The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Platform Strategy partners closely with Digital’s Product Management teams to ensure enterprise AI capabilities can be easily integrated, adopted, and leveraged across the firm.

This role ensures the adoption of responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory expectations, while clearly communicating progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. Working in collaboration with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas , the Director, AI Product Manager – AI Platform Strategy ensures that vendor AI platform capabilities deliver measurable value, maintain performance through ongoing monitoring, and support firmwide strategic objectives through shared AI capability development. The role acts as a connector throughout the full product lifecycle—navigating ideation, discovery, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

This position sits within the AI Platform Team
inside EJ Labs
, focused on building and managing the reusable AI platform and marketplace capabilities that enable teams across the enterprise to discover, govern, scale, and consume AI products through a consistent, standards-based ecosystem, rather than developing one-off or front-end solutions.

What You'll Do

Defines the strategic vision, priorities, and roadmap for enterprise AI platform capabilities
Identifies and prioritizes high-value platform opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, reusability, adoption potential, risk, and enterprise alignment.
Guides investment, sequencing, build-buy-partner, and vendor decisions for AI platform capabilities.
Connects AI platform strategy to business strategy, data strategy, agentic priorities, product strategy, architecture, and innovation goals.
Builds alignment across business, technology, engineering, data, product management, experience, risk, security, and governance stakeholders.
Shapes strategic narratives and decision materials that clarify trade-offs, outcomes, dependencies, risks, and required investments.
Conducts market, user, and technology research to anticipate emerging platform needs and external developments.
Defines success measures for platform value, builder experience, reuse, adoption, reliability, interoperability, and risk.
Drives adoption of platform capabilities among AI builders, AI product managers, and downstream consumers.
Ensures responsible AI, regulatory, security, privacy, and governance requirements are incorporated into platform strategy and lifecycle decisions.
Partners with delivery and engineering leaders to translate strategic direction into executable roadmaps and realistic delivery pathways.
Blends AI capabilities with human capabilities to strengthen builder productivity, organizational readiness, and sustainable adoption.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, business, strategy, product management or related field.
Significant experience in AI strategy, platform strategy, technology strategy, AI product management, business transformation, or enterprise innovation.
7+ years’ experience in product management includes translating business needs into technical requirements and leading product discovery and validation.
3+ years' experience in AI/ML.
Strong understanding of AI technologies and financial services.
Product operating model methodologies, including AI driven PDLC.
AI technologies and their applications in business contexts.
Metrics and frameworks for tracking product AI model and agent success and impact.
Responsible AI practices and regulatory compliance requirements.
Strategic vendor management, platform evaluation, technology partnerships, and enterprise AI platform governance.
Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management skills with the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and external technology partners.
Demonstrated ability to influence vendor roadmaps and establish strategic partnerships that support enterprise AI objectives and long-term AI platform evolution.

What will set you apart:

Master’s Degree in Artificial Intelligence, Product Management, or a related field.
5+ years’ experience in AI product management, with a focus on responsible AI practices and regulatory compliance in a financial services context.
Financial services industry practices and regulations.
Emerging trends in AI product model and agent development and management.
Data governance and integrity management.
Risk management and compliance in AI product AI model and agent development.
Advanced data visualization techniques for product insights.

At Edward Jones, we are building a place where everyone feels like they belong. We're proud of our associates' contributions to the firm and the recognitions we have received.

Check out our U.S. awards and accolades: Insights & Information Blog Postings about Edward Jones

Check out our Canadian awards and accolades: Insights & Information Blog Postings about Edward Jones

Edward Jones does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Edward Jones' compensation and benefits package includes medical and prescription drug, dental, vision, voluntary benefits (such as accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness), short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage. Short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage are provided at no cost to associates. Edward Jones offers a 401k retirement plan, and tax-advantaged accounts: health savings account, and flexible spending account. Edward Jones observes ten paid holidays and provides 15 days of vacation for new associates beginning on January 1 of each year, as well as sick time, personal days, and a paid day for volunteerism. Associates may be eligible for bonuses and profit sharing. All associates are eligible for the firm's Employee Assistance Program. For more information on the Benefits available to Edward Jones associates, please visit our benefits page.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

The Senior Engineering Manager, Software Development will lead a team responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software for the Affera mapping system. This role will provide technical leadership, people management, and cross-functional execution oversight to deliver safe, high-quality, and innovative software solutions that support product performance, regulatory compliance, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate will have deep experience leading software engineering teams in a regulated environment, with strong expertise in software architecture, product development, testing methodologies, and team development.

About The Affera Mapping And Ablation System

The Affera Mapping and Ablation System is an innovative medical technology designed to treat patients with cardiac arrhythmias. The system involves advanced mapping techniques to create detailed images of the heart's electrical activity, helping physicians identify abnormal areas causing arrhythmias. Once identified, the Affera Ablation System delivers targeted energy to disrupt these abnormal signals, restoring normal heart rhythm.

Lead and develop a high-performing software engineering team responsible for core product software.

jobs.description:

Information, Please See

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Marketing Technology is a senior leadership role

responsible for setting the vision and firmwide strategy for Jenner &

Block\'s marketing technology architecture (MarTech) in collaboration

with the Chief Business Development & Marketing Officer (ie. CRM, email

marketing, Experience Management, pitch/proposal generation, and

connected data platforms). The Senior Manager, Marketing Technology will

translate that MarTech strategy into action and drive results to

completion. This role is one that requires the ability to assess firm

needs and resources, communicate clearly on deliverables and timing and

deliver on results, incorporating the vision and strategy into practical

application.

The role will lead the firm\'s migration from InterAction to Salesforce

and the build-out of a unified marketing data platform that brings CRM,

email marketing (currently Vuture), Experience Management, and

pitch/proposal data together as a single source for reporting and

business development insight. The Senior Manager will serve as the

firm\'s primary business owner and strategic partner to the third-party

implementation partner engaged for the CRM and platform builds, leading

or Director of Engineering

Candidates hired at the Director level will serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, helping shape operational strategy and long-term organizational success. Regardless of level, the successful candidate will play a critical role in advancing manufacturing performance, developing technical talent, supporting operational scalability, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Applicable to both Engineering Manager and Director of Engineering levels

Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, SPC, Theory of Constraints (TOC), and other operational excellence methodologies.
Drive manufacturing process optimization, process standardization, workflow improvements, and engineering support for production operations.
Partner closely with Operations, Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Leadership teams to achieve organizational objectives.
Analyze operational, quality, and production metrics to identify trends, improve efficiencies, and support data-driven decision-making.
Support new product development, manufacturing implementation, and process scalability initiatives.
Lead root cause analysis, corrective action activities, and quality improvement efforts to improve product consistency and customer satisfaction.
Oversee engineering support for manufacturing technologies, automation initiatives, equipment implementation, and process modernization activities.
Develop, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures, engineering documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Manage engineering projects, priorities, and resources while ensuring objectives are completed on time and within budget.

Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.

Minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams, quality functions, or technical organizations.

Experience managing cross-functional engineering and quality initiatives within a manufacturing environment.

The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Platform Strategy
is responsible for driving the AI platform vision, strategy, and cross-functional coordination across the AI Platform team acting as the lead for AI vendor engagement. This role establishes and optimizes the platforms, environments, and enabling infrastructure required to develop, deploy, monitor, and scale artificial intelligence solutions. Focuses on creating secure, reliable, interoperable, and reusable foundations for enterprise AI delivery and operations.

Unlike ‑Product Managers within the Digital Product Management organization, this role treats AI itself as the product
—owning firmwide, reusable, and scalable AI platform capabilities that power AI builder experiences and AI products rather than discrete applications.

This role centers on strategy, discovery, and value framing, working closely with each Business and Functional area to shape AI direction, identify high‑value opportunities, and expand the art of the possible for how AI can transform their domain. Digital Product Managers will often serve as customers of the AI Product Manager, and leverage AI Products as part of their offerings. Digital Product Managers will remain accountable for the execution, delivery, and lifecycle management of AI capabilities within products and portfolios. The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Platform Strategy partners closely with Digital’s Product Management teams to ensure enterprise AI capabilities can be easily integrated, adopted, and leveraged across the firm.

This role ensures the adoption of responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory expectations, while clearly communicating progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. Working in collaboration with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas , the Director, AI Product Manager – AI Platform Strategy ensures that vendor AI platform capabilities deliver measurable value, maintain performance through ongoing monitoring, and support firmwide strategic objectives through shared AI capability development. The role acts as a connector throughout the full product lifecycle—navigating ideation, discovery, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

This position sits within the AI Platform Team
inside EJ Labs

new_jobs.description:

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Marketing Technology is a senior leadership role

responsible for setting the vision and firmwide strategy for Jenner &

Block\'s marketing technology architecture (MarTech) in collaboration

with the Chief Business Development & Marketing Officer (ie. CRM, email

marketing, Experience Management, pitch/proposal generation, and

connected data platforms). The Senior Manager, Marketing Technology will

translate that MarTech strategy into action and drive results to

completion. This role is one that requires the ability to assess firm

needs and resources, communicate clearly on deliverables and timing and

deliver on results, incorporating the vision and strategy into practical

application.

The role will lead the firm\'s migration from InterAction to Salesforce

and the build-out of a unified marketing data platform that brings CRM,

email marketing (currently Vuture), Experience Management, and

pitch/proposal data together as a single source for reporting and

business development insight. The Senior Manager will serve as the

firm\'s primary business owner and strategic partner to the third-party

implementation partner engaged for the CRM and platform builds, leading

the MarTech team in execution and driving the firm\'s ongoing MarTech

strategy.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

Lead MarTech strategy in partnership with the Chief Business

Development & Marketing Officer, the BDM team, Communications team,

IT, Finance and other departments across the firm, with a clear

understanding of how systems and data flow between them.

Leverage knowledge of firmwide initiatives (e.g., Salesforce

platform, Experience Management, and marketing campaign programs) to

guide technology investments and decisions across Business

Development & Marketing, Communications and the firm.

Own Salesforce architecture and governance including security,

permissions, data validation, and automation to ensure the platform

remains reliable, well-governed, and built to scale as the firm\'s

data footprint grows.

Lead the end-to-end migration of the firm\'s CRM from InterAction to

Salesforce, including requirements gathering, data mapping,

configuration, testing, training, and adoption.

Serve as a primary point of accountability to the third-party

implementation vendor for the CRM and Salesforce platform builds.

Execution of a unified business development and marketing data

platform, integrating CRM, email marketing (currently Vuture),

Experience Management, And Pitch/proposal Data And Additional

marketing data sources over time into a single, governed environment

that powers firmwide reporting and business development insight.

Set the vision for the firm\'s business development and marketing

data architecture, ensuring the data that the Business Development

and Marketing Teams needs are available in the systems where they

work.

With the MarTech team, oversee the firm\'s Experience Management

platform and pitch/proposal generation tool, partnering with

Business Development and Marketing on requirements and ensuring both

integrate cleanly into the CRM and Salesforce platform architecture.

Champion the marketing campaign management capabilities within the

MarTech stack, ensuring the CRM, email marketing, and Salesforce

platform infrastructure can support scalable, well-executed

campaigns, in partnership with Business Development, Marketing and

Communications.

Elevate data governance, data quality, and privacy compliance from a

platform-level responsibility to a firmwide framework, partnering

with IT, Records/Risk, Finance and outside counsel as needed, and

monitoring th evolving data privacy landscape to keep the

department\'s practices current.

Track market and competitive trends in legal marketing technology to

inform investment priorities and differentiate the firm\'s

capabilities.

Oversee and manage team members, supporting their professional

growth and development.

Partner with Business Development and Marketing, Web, IT, AI, HR,

Finance and other departments on technology decisions and firmwide

initiatives, reflecting MarTech priorities for the firm.

Communicate with confidence and credibility across departments,

translating technical concepts into business outcomes for

non-technical audiences.

Develop and manage the MarTech budget across the full stack,

forecasting investment needs as the firm\'s data and platform

footprint grows.

Serve as an escalation point for cross-system, firmwide, or

vendor-level issues beyond first-line support.

Stay current on AI-enabled capabilities across the MarTech landscape

(e.g., AI features within Salesforce, email marketing/automation

platforms, and data/reporting tools) and evaluate where they can

improve data quality, efficiency, or insight bringing

recommendations to firm leadership and adapting the team\'s tools

and workflows as the landscape evolves.

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering, UAS Development
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About The Role

As the Director of Engineering for UAS Development at Harmattan AI, you will build and lead an engineering organisation with various engineering modules from the ground up.

You will own the full technical chain, take the system through qualification and into series production, and build a supplier base and engineering ecosystem that sustains it.

Responsibilities

Organisation Building: Stand up the engineering group including hiring key engineering roles.
Project Management: Act as a project manager handling the delivery of key milestones.
Technical Ownership: Own the full technical chain across airframe, propulsion, avionics, launcher and ground segment, through to flight test and trials.
People Management & Mentorship: Manage managers while staying close to the engineering — run regular design reviews across multiple disciplines.
Supplier Ecosystem: Develop a supplier base.

Candidate Requirements

Educational Background: An MSc in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical or a strongly related engineering field. A track record of building organisations will outweigh the degree.
Proven Leadership: An engineer who moved into management and then into managing managers.
Experience: 10+ years, with at least 4 in engineering management. You have stood up or materially scaled an engineering site — including hiring at pace.
Track Record: You have taken a hardware system through qualification and into series production. Background in UAV, autonomous systems or advanced robotics.
Technical Engagement: While this is a leadership role, you remain credible across every discipline in the group without claiming depth in any, and you take written positions on the cross-module questions no one else will close.
Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of building autonomous defence systems

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
